entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in G.R. Case No.527 of 2023 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C-III (Cog. Taking), Cuttack, arising out of Malgodown P.S. Case No.143 of 2023 for commission of the alleged offence under Sections 420/272/273 IPC and Sections 51/52/59/63/57 of the Food Safety and Stand Act and Section 14 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned 1st Addl.
Sessions Judge, Cuttack by order dated 16.08.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 22.7.2023 and the allegation against him is that he is actively involved in adulterating the spices by adding chemical colour etc. which are not fit for human consumption.
5.
Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail during currency of investigation.
6. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the Petitioner is the first offender.

7. Taking into account the same and keeping in view the period of custody and the punishment prescribed, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the Arun Kumar Gantayat vs State Of Odisha ....
